Migration.Method: RequirementsAnalysis was decomposed into project context, actors, use cases, constraints, risks, and open questions.

Project.Name: autoheat
Project.Purpose: Flutter application for automatic Changan seat heating through Android Automotive HVAC and sensor APIs.
Project.Keywords: flutter, dart, android-automotive, changan, hvac, seat-heating, head-unit, foreground-service, bloc, cubit
Project.ProductBoundary: Controls driver and passenger seat heating in manual, presets, and automatic temperature-driven modes; continues in a foreground service and switches heating off after ignition OFF.

Actors.Driver: Primary operator who controls the driver's seat heating through the UI.
Actors.Passenger: Front passenger with an independent seat-heating level.
Actors.VehicleSystem: Background service that reacts to ignition and cabin-temperature events.
Actors.ChanganVehicle: Vehicle HVAC and sensors exposed through android.car APIs and the local AndroidAutomotivePlugin.

UC-001.Action: Select a seat-heating level from 0 to 3 in manual mode.
UC-001.Goal: Apply the requested level immediately and reflect it in the UI and persisted state.
UC-001.Preconditions: HvacService is initialized and the active mode is manual.
UC-001.AcceptanceCriteria: HVAC receives the corresponding property value; SharedPreferences and the visible state are updated.

UC-002.Action: Run automatic heating from cabin temperature and configured threshold/durations.
UC-002.Goal: Warm the active seat using the 3 to 2 to 1 to 0 sequence without repeated timer restarts for equivalent sensor events.
UC-002.Preconditions: Automatic mode is active and a valid cabin-temperature reading is available.
UC-002.AcceptanceCriteria: Temperature events are converted and published; one effective plan per user is scheduled; levels reach zero at completion.

UC-003.Action: Create, edit, select, apply, and delete a heating preset.
UC-003.Goal: Reuse independent heating configurations for each user.
UC-003.AcceptanceCriteria: Preset settings and selected preset identity persist per user; applying a preset changes runtime heating state.

UC-004.Action: Keep heating control alive in the foreground service and stop both seats after ignition OFF.
UC-004.Goal: Preserve autonomous behavior across app backgrounding and avoid heating after the vehicle is switched off.
UC-004.AcceptanceCriteria: UI and background isolates initialize their own idempotent DI; ignition OFF is awaited and bounded retry-backoff is applied.

Constraints.Runtime: Android Automotive OS head unit, arm64, Changan UNI-S/CS55 Plus family, MediaTek MT8666.
Constraints.Integration: All vehicle access goes through packages/android_automotive_plugin, a local snapshot of the upstream Changan library.
Constraints.Persistence: HeatMode and UserType enum names plus SharedPreferences keys are stable public contracts.
Constraints.Isolation: Background onStart has an isolated DI path and must remain synchronized with the UI bootstrap.
Constraints.TemperatureConversion: Current conversion is (raw - 84) / 2 degrees Celsius and remains a deferred empirical-validation risk.

Risks.Risk-1: Native HVAC connection or property access can fail outside the head unit or after an OTA update; failures must not crash the process.
Risks.Risk-2: Cold-boot notification timing may require restoring a one-second initialization delay if the foreground service does not start.
Risks.Risk-3: Temperature conversion may vary by Changan model and needs a physical head-unit smoke check.
Risks.Risk-4: Background DI drift can silently disable ignition and sensor handling.

OpenQuestions.Question-1: Validate raw-to-Celsius accuracy on the target head unit before extracting a model-specific temperature profile.
OpenQuestions.Question-2: Decide whether native HVAC write failures should be exposed as a user-visible UI error; current behavior logs and propagates the failure.
OpenQuestions.Question-3: Introduce an in-app HVAC diagnostic inspector only when the deferred diagnostic trigger is accepted.
